notes: Meta has NO first-party inference API today. The Llama API launched as a public preview in April 2025, never left preview, and was sunset on 2026-07-06; requests after that date return a sunset response.
This entry exists so the question is answered rather than re-researched. It is deliberately unpriced.
Llama weights remain open and Llama models are served by Bedrock, Vertex, Together, Groq and Fireworks — each with its own pricing, which belongs in those providers' files, not here.
The deprecation date was corroborated across two searches of Meta's own docs domain; the page itself would not render on direct fetch.
